Based on the provided evidence, the penalties for late submission of returns are covered under the following sections, depending on the type of institution and the specific act:

*   **Section 42(4) of the RBI Act, 1934**: Applies to banks for failure to submit or late submission of returns [RBI_RBI_2006-2007_106_August_08__2006_Section_42__1__of_the_RBI_Act__1934_23_DBOD__b7ceaa7f_chunk_28].
*   **Section 46(4) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949**: Applies to non-scheduled co-operative banks for failure to submit prescribed statutory returns in time under Section 18 and 24 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 [RBI_RBI_2006-2007_106_August_08__2006_Section_42__1__of_the_RBI_Act__1934_23_DBOD__b7ceaa7f_chunk_28].
*   **Section 26 of the Payment and Settlement Systems (PSS) Act, 2007**: Defines offences including "failure to produce any statement, information, returns or documents" and "non-compliance of RBI directions or failure to pay the penalty imposed by RBI," which are punishable with imprisonment or fine or both [RBI_RBI_2019-20_140_DPSS.CO.OD.No.1328_06.08.005_2019-20__b77e3e1c_chunk_4].
*   **Section 30 of the PSS Act, 2007**: Empowers the RBI to impose a penalty not exceeding ₹ 5 lakh or twice the amount involved in such contravention or default (whichever is more) for contraventions mentioned in Section 26(2) and 26(6) of the Act [RBI_RBI_2019-20_140_DPSS.CO.OD.No.1328_06.08.005_2019-20__b77e3e1c_chunk_4].
